blind.description: A stylised dark spider clutching a large pale cream-coloured egg or sac beneath its body, resting inside a low circular rimmed base. The spider has a green dorsal stripe along its abdomen and small green eye clusters. The legs curve downward tightly around the egg, anchoring to the base rim. Surfaces are smooth, solid, and cleanly modelled with no detached fragments, holes, or melting.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a top-down view of a dark spider with a neon green central stripe and green eyes, with its legs splayed symmetrically around the pale egg within a circular dark disc.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 the height of the figure (around 1.5 feet tall) and roughly 1.5 to 2 feet in diameter.
